title: Archuleta reports a crashed plane to the Air Force
place_text: Archuleta ranch / Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: He calls the Air Force and he [music] says, "Hey, one of your planes crashed over here. You need to come get it."

plain: In 1948, a man named Valentine Archeletta called the Air Force, at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, to say, "Hey, one of your planes crashed over here. You need to come get it," about something that had come down on his ranch. Scott Ramsey, who tells the story, passes on what Archeletta said, and tells it as the start of a crash that, in Ramsey's account, was no ordinary plane.
